propositions: models_at_or_above() falls through to full ladder for a truthy but unlocated primary, causing escalation to downgrade window and jump provider family instead of staying on operator's model.
largest_window_tokens() returns ladder maximum for unlocated primary instead of conservative minimum, causing window to be overstated and P8 under-blocking.
Prerequisite-coverage escalation at prerequisites.py:260-261 exhibits same defect (downgrades to claude-haiku-4-5) despite prerequisites.py itself being unedited after the fix.
For a non-Anthropic-family primary, passing batch then single-criterion retry should occur before firing _too_big, but current behaviour skips to failure after first attempt.
Window consumers (verify_request_chunks, pack_prerequisite_bins, pack_prerequisite_verifier_bins) all divide by largest_window_tokens, so conservative minimum is safer than optimistic maximum.
Test assertions in test_model_class_ladder.py pinned the old behaviour and require update to new contract (explicit return of unlocated primary, not full ladder).
